initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.1. R293-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no identifying restriction on exposure assignment. Thus the descriptive contrast is established, while the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified.
